message.content:
I don’t have access to live market feeds, so I can’t give you the exact spot price of gold for today.  The most reliable way to get the current U.S. gold price is to check a reputable financial news source or market data platform such as:

| Source | How to find the price |
|--------|-----------------------|
| Bloomberg | Search “Gold Spot” or look under commodities → metals |
| Reuters | Look up “Gold (XAU/USD)” on their market page |
| Kitco | Their “Gold Prices” page shows the latest spot price in USD per troy ounce |
| CME Group | The COMEX Gold futures quote reflects the current spot level |
| Yahoo Finance | Search “XAUUSD” or “Gold” for the spot price chart |

As of the last published data (usually updated at the close of the U.S. trading day), gold typically trades somewhere between **$1,800–$2,000 per troy ounce** in the U.S., but the exact figure can fluctuate by the minute during trading hours.

If you need the precise price for a specific time, you’ll want to consult one of those real‑time feeds or your brokerage’s market data.
